name: okb
description: Lets each person work in their firm's Real Agent knowledge base, its organisational knowledge base (OKB), in the firm's own Supabase project, within their own permissions: records, files and their search, the glossary and data dictionary, boards, graphs and printed PDFs.

project_ref.title: Project reference
project_ref.description: The client's Supabase project reference, under Project Settings → General in the Supabase dashboard. Used in a folder with no actor file; a folder signed in with okb sign-in --folder names its own project.

auth_email.title: Auth user's email
auth_email.description: The email address the person signs in with, in a folder with no actor file.

agent_folder.title: Agent folder
agent_folder.description: The one folder the person puts files in for the agent, which uploads read from, and where the agent reads JSON for a call's arguments, writes a call's result, and draws and prints pages, in a folder with no actor file. Leave it empty to allow none of these.

whisper_cli.title: whisper.cpp program
whisper_cli.description: The full path of whisper.cpp's whisper-cli program, which transcribes recordings read from the agent folder. Leave it empty where Homebrew installed it.

whisper_model.title: whisper.cpp model
whisper_model.description: The full path of whisper.cpp's ggml-base.bin model. Leave it empty where Homebrew installed it.
